name: VANDIRA Audit / Compliance / Security Intelligence
purpose: Evidence-aware runtime audit, security headers, data-integrity checks and deployment-safety controls.
rules: Canonical election data must remain byte-identical unless an explicit versioned data update is approved.
Provider secrets must remain server-side and must never be serialized into browser responses.
Audit metadata is not claimed to be tamper-proof unless durable audit storage is configured.
No sensitive voter attributes or inferred sensitive profiles are stored in audit events.
Production domain remains untouched during development steps.
Current political claims require fresh evidence and provenance.
Security status must distinguish configured controls from merely planned controls.
compliance_position: engineering control layer; not legal certification
